change_summary: PLOS ONE retracted this article because of concerns about peer review integrity and possible manipulation of the publication process. The editors say these concerns call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results. The author did not respond or could not be reached. The retraction covers the whole article, not a single part.
evaluation: Your draft cites Dutta [14] as the main evidence for choosing an LSTM in Section 3 and takes its model settings as the starting configuration in Section 4. The paper has been retracted over concerns about peer review integrity, and the editors say these concerns call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results. Both uses are touched, and the change matters a lot because your model choice and your starting settings rest on this paper.
recommendation: Raise this with your co-authors or supervisor, because PLOS ONE retracted the article and the editors say the concerns "call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results", while your Section 3 choice and Section 4 starting settings rest on it. Replace the evidence and don't rely on the reported settings without another source.
